official: 東京都板橋区幼保連携型認定こども園の学級の編制、職員、設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 議案の審査状況（令和8年第3回定例会）

name: 認定こども園の職員配置と防止措置を変更
summary: 幼保連携型認定こども園の職員配置などの基準を定めた条例を改正します。配置に努める職員の種類に主務養護教諭を加え、特定の環境で園児と接する業務の従事者について、設置者に犯罪事実確認などの措置を義務付けます。第18条の改正は令和8年12月25日から、その他の改正は公布日から施行します。
changes: 配置に努める職員の種別に主務養護教諭を加える
支配性、継続性及び閉鎖性のある環境で園児と接する業務の従事者について、犯罪事実確認などの措置を設置者に義務付ける
who: 幼保連携型認定こども園の設置者
園児と接する業務に従事する人
why: 主務省令の改正に伴い、犯罪事実確認などの規定を設け、配置に努める職員の種別に主務養護教諭を加える必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes staffing and prevention measures at certified integrated childcare centers
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Itabashi City Ordinance Establishing Standards for Class Organization, Staff, Facilities, and Operation of Certified Centers for Early Childhood Education and Care Integrating Kindergarten and Nursery Functions
en.summary: This amends the ordinance that sets standards for staffing and other matters at certified centers for early childhood education and care integrating kindergarten and nursery functions. It adds a lead school health teacher to the types of staff whose assignment the centers should endeavor to ensure. It also requires operators to take measures, including criminal record checks, for people whose work involves contact with children in settings characterized by dominance, continuity, and closedness. The amendment to Article 18 takes effect on December 25, 2026. The other amendments take effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Adds a lead school health teacher to the types of staff whose assignment centers should endeavor to ensure
Requires operators to take measures, including criminal record checks, for people whose work involves contact with children in settings characterized by dominance, continuity, and closedness
who: Operators of certified centers for early childhood education and care integrating kindergarten and nursery functions
People engaged in work involving contact with children
en.why: The ward says this is necessary because the relevant ministerial ordinance was amended, requiring provisions on criminal record checks and other measures and the addition of a lead school health teacher to the types of staff whose assignment centers should endeavor to ensure.
